descriptors.R: nominee of the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 1994 elections; until June the Senate majority leader
descriptors.D: the sitting President, nominee of the party that has held the White House since 1993
descriptors.O: nominee of a newly founded third party; a self-funded business executive who ran as an independent in 1992 and took nearly a fifth of the vote, running on balancing the budget, term limits and campaign and lobbying reform

compile_desc.R: the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 1994 elections
compile_desc.D: the party that has held the White House since 1993

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including a Green, a Libertarian and a Taxpayers party nominee (answer "other").
never_name: Dole, Clinton, Perot, Gore, Kemp, Choate, Gingrich, Buchanan, Forbes, Nader or Harry Browne

slice_sources.men: 1990 and 2000 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1996; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1996); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 1996 returns.
slice_sources.women: 1990 and 2000 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1996; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1996); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 1996 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 1990 and 2000 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1996; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1996); calibrated to the certified 1996 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 1990 and 2000 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1996; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1996), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 1996 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 1990 and 2000 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1996; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the congressional majority party
